scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tools/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: bun run types && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun test
scripts.verify: bun run check && bunx vite build && bun scripts/deploy.ts --dry-run --outdir .claude/temp/dryrun
scripts.db:migrate: vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply agent-drop-db --remote -c web/dist/agent_drop/wrangler.json
scripts.db:migrate:local: vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply agent-drop-db --local --persist-to web/.wrangler/state -c web/dist/agent_drop/wrangler.json
